changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.transfers ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, description text, id_from_wallet bigint NOT NULL, id_to_wallet bigint NOT NULL, id_returned_transfer bigint, CONSTRAINT transfers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT transfers_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT transfers_id_returned_transfer_key UNIQUE (id_returned_transfer), CONSTRAINT ck_transfers_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_transfers_on_wallets CHECK (id_from_wallet <> id_to_wallet), CONSTRAINT fk_from_wallets_on_transfers FOREIGN KEY (id_from_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id), CONSTRAINT fk_to_wallets_on_transfers FOREIGN KEY (id_to_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id), CONSTRAINT fk_transfers_on_transfers FOREIGN KEY (id_returned_transfer) REFERENCES financial.transfers (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_transfers_on_from_wallet ON financial.transfers (id_from_wallet); CREATE INDEX ix_transfers_on_to_wallet ON financial.transfers (id_to_wallet);
